product_one_liner.value: Paddle is an all-in-one merchant-of-record payments and billing platform for SaaS, mobile-app, AI, and digital-product companies, providing checkout, subscriptions, global tax compliance, metrics, fraud protection, and retention tools through one API.
product_one_liner.notes: The developer guide describes the product and its target customer types.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists pay-as-you-go and custom pricing, including a transaction rate.

named_customers.notes: Paddle names these companies among those that trust it.

employee_band.notes: Paddle’s LinkedIn company profile lists company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company profile lists London, England, United Kingdom.

founded_year.notes: Paddle is listed as founded in 2012.

eng_blog.notes: The product-and-engineering team blog includes multiple technical build posts, including posts on microservices, webhooks, and chaos testing.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation provides multiple guides, quickstarts, and product-integration resources.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists open Head of Data Science and Senior AI Engineer roles.

model_provider.value: Google Gemini 2.5 (AI Node in Taktile seller-onboarding/risk workflows)
model_provider.notes: The Trust Center subprocessor listing names an AI Node using the Gemini 2.5 model within Taktile onboarding/risk workflows; this is a specifically scoped disclosed use.

compliance_certs.notes: Paddle’s Trust Center names SOC 2, PCI DSS 4.0.1, and GDPR under Compliance.

last_funding.notes: Paddle announced $25 million from CIBC Innovation Banking on July 17, 2025; coverage identifies the financing as debt.

raised_18mo.notes: The $25 million financing was announced July 17, 2025, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers listings include a Senior Account Executive and a Business Development Representative posting.

launched_6mo.notes: Paddle announced the AI Toolkit and native usage-based billing capabilities on October 20, 2026, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current official About page lists a small leadership team; the latest located executive-hire announcement is dated July 17, 2025, before the 12-month window beginning November 9, 2025, and no in-window C-level/VP change or departure was located.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Paddle lifecycle-marketing job description identifies HubSpot as one of its engagement tools.
